name: Furnace / HVAC
scene: An upright furnace or air handler on the floor of a utility room: cabinet with a removable front door panel, filter slot on the side or bottom return with the filter sliding out, blower compartment at the bottom, return and supply ducts, power switch on a box nearby, condensate drain line, and the wall thermostat on a wall panel beside it.
size: Cabinet 0.45-0.6 m wide, 1.1-1.3 m tall, 0.7 m deep; filter 0.4 x 0.64 x 0.025 m (16x25x1) or 0.1 m thick media filter.

parts.label: Furnace
parts.describe: Painted sheet-metal cabinet with louvers, label and sight glass.

parts.label: Air filter
parts.describe: Pleated filter in a cardboard frame in the filter slot (between the return duct and the cabinet, usually the side or bottom); slides out sideways or forward, with an arrow showing airflow.

parts.label: Dust
parts.describe: Grey dust on the old filter (lint patch, child of the filter).

parts.label: Front panel
parts.describe: Upper or lower access door on the front; lifts up and out.

parts.label: Power switch
parts.describe: Light-switch style service switch on a box on the side or nearby wall.

parts.label: Thermostat
parts.describe: Wall thermostat on a wall panel next to the furnace (modelled at the real 1.4 m height); display and buttons or a dial.

parts.label: Thermostat buttons
parts.describe: Up/down keys or the mode button on the thermostat.

parts.label: Thermostat cover
parts.describe: Face that pulls off the base to reach the batteries.

parts.label: Condensate drain
parts.describe: PVC drain line with a trap from the side of the cabinet to a floor drain or pump.

parts.label: Door switch
parts.describe: Small push switch the panel presses; the furnace will not run with the panel off.

views: on the wall for the thermostat
notes: Ducts are large boxes on the top (supply) and the side or bottom (return). Draw an airflow arrow on the filter frame with a label like '→ AIRFLOW'.
